name: P-School 戦闘画像（ステージ3〜20の敵と背景）
style: Art style: match the reference images. Hand-painted 2D fantasy adventure game art with soft painterly shading, clean edges, warm natural light from the upper left, rich but natural colours and anime-influenced proportions. Friendly enough for a children's coding game: menacing but never gory or horrifying. Not pixel art. No text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, signature, frame or border.

sprite.rules: One enemy only, full body from head to feet, turned three-quarters in a side view, seen from eye level, standing on an invisible ground line near the bottom edge, filling most of the image with a small margin. Facing LEFT, toward the hero. Use the reference images for the art style only; do not draw the characters in them.
sprite.transparent: Transparent background: no scenery, no ground and no cast shadow.
sprite.flat: Plain flat pure white background (#FFFFFF): no scenery, no ground, no shadow and no gradient.

background: Wide battle background for a side-view game, seen from eye level. A flat walkable ground area fills the lower third across the whole width, where the hero stands on the left and an enemy on the right; keep the left and right middle areas free of large objects. No characters, creatures or people, and no UI. Use the reference image for the art style and rendering only; do not copy its content.
